summary: Uxin Ltd, a Nasdaq-listed Chinese used car retailer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 24, 2026, containing an Exhibit 99.1 press release reporting unaudited second-quarter 2026 results for the period ended June 30, 2026. Transaction volume totaled 21,899 units, with retail volume of 19,610 units; total revenues were RMB1,151.2 million (US$169.7 million). Gross margin was negative 0.7%, operating loss RMB151.9 million, and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA loss RMB119.8 million. CEO Kun Dai and CFO Feng Lin commented; no transaction, stake, or board recommendation is stated. Watch inventory pricing and margin recovery.
